$comment: Hand-edited. The package's typed shapes are generated from it.
title: ReadRequest
description: read_side_contract.md section 1. A reader checks a request member by member at step 0, refusing with reasons, and ignores a member not named here, at any depth.

material_ref.description: A material reference: a record's id and version, and its content hash as the pin.

want.description: read_side_contract.md section 6. reference_data, fit and coverage belong to the fits and reference data suite.

requirement_condition.description: A tolerance for a numeric condition, an accept list for a token condition (provenance.md section 6.1).

tolerance.description: Absolute, in the condition's registered unit.

acceptance.description: An acceptance of a kind a read takes (read_side_contract.md section 1; declarations.md section 4.1). An acceptance of any other kind, or one that breaks its shape, refuses the request.

acceptance_members.description: What every acceptance holds beside its kind's own members (declarations.md section 4.1): the field it names, checked as a target's is; and where it applies, its record, region or interval. A read applies one only to a read of the field it names, at its own record: one located at a region, at an interval or nowhere is checked and not applied, and step 0 does not check a location's shape. A read ignores its reason and basis.

record.description: The record it applies at, by id, version and content_hash, the members of a material reference.

interval.description: An interval of a layered path (geometry.md), which no request targets.

reason.description: Why the consumer declares it; a read ignores it.

basis.description: What it rests on; a read ignores it.

pick_or_overlay.description: A pick or an overlay (declarations.md section 4.1). Their own members are written with the steps that apply them, with alternatives and overlays.

extrapolation_acceptance.description: How the consumer computes a value outside a form's range, from the end value a read under it returns (declarations.md section 4.1). A read applies it only under want value, outside the readable range, at no declared edge and across none (read_side_contract.md section 5).

law.description: Text of at least one character, which a reader does not judge: white space alone is accepted.

nominal_acceptance.description: A value for an interval, in the field's registered unit. A parameter set's nominal holds params in place of a value; no field of this version takes a parameter set, and a read ignores params.

implied_condition_acceptance.description: A value for each condition in implies, which fills a condition the record holds as unstated or does not hold, on a field whose specimen states the fact and its token.

fact.description: A specimen fact whose shape has a token member.

implies.description: Per registered condition, a record condition's shape of that condition's kind without basis, plus_minus or set_or_measured, and never a status object: a numeric condition's holds no token, and a token condition's no value, range or unit (read_side_contract.md section 1).

implies_value.description: A value or a range with its unit, in the condition's registered unit, for a numeric condition; a token of its row for a token condition.
